descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-15 ER; TFA-92593 AC 8 · “Temperatures are quoted in the stored unit (°C stays °C).”. Mixed: stated part — 38.1 °C and 100.6 °F quoted in their stored unit; our part — bare-number temperature (D2 open) (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Decision D2 · S0 · Preston

Is adding a unit to a bare value (temperature 38 → 38 °C, 60 → 60 °F) an 'invented unit'? (GK11)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-23/S15, TC-23/S16

Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S16 Stored temperature unit is kept: °C (NH and Hospital), °F (Hospital), bare number (Hospital)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Temperatures are quoted in the stored unit (°C stays °C, °F stays °F). (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 8)
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 3; UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Vitals temp stored as '38.1 °C' (main, NH); variants: Hospital '38.1 °C', Hospital '100.6 °F', Hospital bare 37.9 / 100.4 / 60

When Type "What was the temperature?"

Then Answer quotes the stored value in the stored unit, never converted; a bare number is not converted

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): °C entries: mustInclude '38.1' and °C/celsius, mustNotInclude °F/100.6/Fahrenheit. °F entry: mustInclude '100.6', mustNotInclude '38.1'/°C/celsius. Bare entries: no conversion in the answer; the context check pins what fmtTemp adds (37.9 → '37.9°C', 100.4 → '100.4°F', 60 → bare) — whether that added unit is allowed is Q4, recorded, not judged

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Preston.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Preston) · environment dev · tickets TFA-92593 ready for qa

Asked about a stored bare temperature of 60, Ask AI answers '60°F', adding a unit the chart never had, although it also flags the value as implausible.

Evidence: Allure 488ca496. Ledger #41 U41: 'Fail → needs Preston (cluster U)'. Dev report §3 row 2 (GK11): does a clinically unambiguous bare temperature count as a guessed unit? 37.9→°C and 100.4→°F were accepted. TFA-92593 AC: temperatures are quoted in the stored unit.
